text:
nate: Big mood: lets have a 'Model Mascot Potluck' Friday. Everyone picks an LLM and brings a snack that matches its personality. :bento:
yasmin: This is peak culture. Im bringing something for 'mistral'  delicate pastries with a mysterious indie vibe. :croissant:
olga: I'll do 'GPT-4 Turbo'  espresso shots and a tiny sign that says 'I will finish your sentence.' :coffee:
nate: Rules idea (quick): 1) no real PD in prompts, 2) label snack with model + decoding mode + a 1-line persona blurb, 3) optional micro-challenges (emoji-only response from the model).
yasmin: Love the labeling. Example tag: "Mistral (temp=0.8)  wistful barista who writes haikus on napkins."
olga: dev-bot  can you generate 3 silly persona blurbs for volunteers so we can print labels?
dev-bot: Generated personas:
- "GPT-4 Turbo (greedy): brusque mentor who abbreviates everything."
- "Mistral (top-p 0.9): artsy roommate who over-explains feelings."
- "Mini-LM (temp 0.6): cheerful intern who loves spreadsheets."
yasmin: Ops-bot  please reserve Kitchen C and add a tiny table for 'Mascot Voting'.
ops-bot: Reserved Kitchen C, Table 1 for Friday 12:00-13:00. Added "Mascot Voting" whiteboard. RSVP below with :wave:.
nate: Micro-challenge idea: have the model write a 2-line endorsement for your snack in-character. We'll tape the endorsement next to each dish. :tada:
olga: Also we should have a "Most Likely to Ship" award for the snack whose model blurb sounds like a PM. :medal:
yasmin: Poster idea: little doodles of models wearing party hats. @design can you?
ola: (typo) meant @olga :grimacing:
olga: I volunteer as taste judge if needed. Also bringing extra napkins because models are messy. :leaning_face_with_hand_over_mouth:
nate: Quick label template we can print:
```
Model: <name> (variant)
Mode: <decoding/temperature>
Persona blurb: <1 line>
Micro-endorsement: <model output>
```
nyasmin: I'll make the labels. Also small request: please no spicy arguments in micro-endorsements. Keep it silly.
olga: Who's in? Drop :wave: if you want to bring a snack and pick a model.
(nate pinned an emoji poll)
nate: Im in  bringing 'GPT-4 Turbo' espresso mints. :wave:
yasmin: In  'Mistral' croissant trifles. :wave:
olga: In  'Mini-LM' sugar cookies. :wave:
ops-bot: Reminder set for Friday 11:00 to prep labels and stickers. See you at the potluck! :balloon:
